desc: Ideate per-prime factorization and flagged height DP approach

Prove the per-prime factorization rigorously: score and gcd condition decompose, so answer is product of independent prime DP values (established in worker's model: per-edge atomic prime powers, min-shift bijection, F_p = G_H − p^N·G_{H−1})

Implement the per-prime flagged height DP solver and validate it against the samples plus a small brute-force enumerator (Sample 1 = 939634344, Sample 2 = 18 verified exactly; brute-force checks on N=3 A=(2,2), A=(6,6), N=2 A=1000 all match)
Verify DP initialization and transitions, especially `dp[h]=p^h` start, zero-step weight `p^h` with run compression, bounds, and min-zero subtraction identity (hand-verified on (p,p) walks)
Tighten complexity/memory: numpy int64 vectorization (no overflow since products < MOD² < 2^63), Σ_p H_p ≤ 9(N−1) giving ~2·10⁷ vectorized ops, well within limits
